Como funciona: o sensor manda para a pla:
How it works: the sensor sends the board a signal that changes with the position of the pin.
The test raises and lowers the pin several times (ONLY the pin, no axis moves) and checks the signal: pin DOWN = "open"; pin RETRACTED = "triggered" (and that is how it is on this firmware). If the signal does not follow the pin, the printer stops with the "BLTouch error" on Home. It heats nothing and takes about 40 s.
